summary: Bank fraud case involving fake/forged title documents for loan collateral; criminal prosecution vs private settlement; charges include IPC s.120-B, 420, 409, 467, 468, 471 and PCA s.13(1)(d), s.13(2); accused wives (nos.3-4) claimed minimal role; High Court dismissed s.482 CrPC petition holding crimes against society cannot be quashed by private settlement; appeal challenged dismissal citing OTS payment and no-due certificate; issue: whether criminal proceedings can continue post-compromise of civil recovery proceedings; standard: compromise in civil suit vs non-compoundable offenses for cheating of public funds.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed against appellants Nos.3-4 (wives) citing minimal role; charges stand against active accused (Nos.1-2); reliance on Duncans Agro Industries precedent for quashing post-compromise where societal harm is mitigated.
